scripts.build: npm run build:npm && npm run build:web && npm run build:c-cpp && npm run build:py && npm run build:jvm && npm run build:swift && npm run build:dart && npm run build:examples
scripts.build:web: cd lavi-wasm && wasm-pack build --target web --out-name lavi
scripts.build:npm: cd lavi-wasm && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-npm --out-name lavi && node ../scripts/build-npm-package.mjs --stage-local && ln -sfn ../lavi-wasm/pkg-npm ../node_modules/lavi-fsm
scripts.build:examples: ln -sfn ../lavi-wasm/pkg-npm node_modules/lavi-fsm && cargo build --manifest-path examples/rust/Cargo.toml && make -C examples/c && make -C examples/cpp && (test -x ./lavi-jvm/gradlew && ./lavi-jvm/gradlew -p examples/java assemble || gradle -p examples/java assemble) && (test -x ./lavi-jvm/gradlew && ./lavi-jvm/gradlew -p examples/kotlin assemble || gradle -p examples/kotlin assemble) && swift build --package-path examples/swift && cd examples/dart && dart pub get
scripts.test: npm run test:conformance-check && npm run test:native && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:c-cpp && npm run test:py && npm run test:jvm && npm run test:swift && npm run test:dart && npm run test:examples && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:c-cpp: npm run build:c-cpp && npm run test:c-cpp:c && npm run test:c-cpp:cpp && npm run test:c-cpp:pio
scripts.test:c-cpp:c: mkdir -p lavi-c-cpp/tests/out && clang lavi-c-cpp/tests/c_test.c -o lavi-c-cpp/tests/out/c_test -I lavi-c-cpp/include -L target/debug -llavi_c_cpp && ./lavi-c-cpp/tests/out/c_test
scripts.test:c-cpp:cpp: mkdir -p lavi-c-cpp/tests/out && clang++ lavi-c-cpp/tests/cpp_test.cpp -o lavi-c-cpp/tests/out/cpp_test -I lavi-c-cpp/include -L target/debug -llavi_c_cpp -std=c++11 && ./lavi-c-cpp/tests/out/cpp_test
scripts.test:py: npm run build:py && PYTHONPATH=lavi-py/python python3 -m pytest lavi-py/tests
scripts.build:jvm: cargo build --package lavi-jvm && (test -x ./lavi-jvm/gradlew && ./lavi-jvm/gradlew -p lavi-jvm assemble || gradle -p lavi-jvm assemble)
scripts.test:jvm: cargo build --package lavi-jvm && (test -x ./lavi-jvm/gradlew && ./lavi-jvm/gradlew -p lavi-jvm test || gradle -p lavi-jvm test)
scripts.build:dart: cargo rustc --package lavi-c-cpp --lib --crate-type cdylib && node scripts/stage-dart-native.mjs && cd lavi-dart && dart pub get
scripts.test:dart: npm run build:dart && cd lavi-dart && dart test
scripts.test:examples: cargo run --manifest-path examples/rust/Cargo.toml && ln -sfn ../lavi-wasm/pkg-npm node_modules/lavi-fsm && node examples/js-wasm/index.mjs && make -C examples/c run && make -C examples/cpp run && PYTHONPATH=lavi-py/python python3 examples/python/main.py && (test -x ./lavi-jvm/gradlew && ./lavi-jvm/gradlew -p examples/java run || gradle -p examples/java run) && (test -x ./lavi-jvm/gradlew && ./lavi-jvm/gradlew -p examples/kotlin run || gradle -p examples/kotlin run) && swift run --package-path examples/swift && (cd examples/dart && dart pub get && dart run bin/main.dart) && clang++ -std=c++11 -fsyntax-only -I examples/esp32/mock_arduino -I lavi-c-cpp/include examples/esp32/test_host_compile.cpp && clang++ -x c++ -std=c++11 -fsyntax-only -I examples/esp32/mock_arduino -I lavi-c-cpp/include examples/esp32/Stoplight/Stoplight.ino
